steps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game foliage sprite texture atlas for the Guns Only Cobra Vietnam level.
Primary request: Create a polished new two-cell foliage atlas using the attached existing atlas ONLY as layout and silhouette reference. Deliver a 2:1 landscape raster, preferably 1024 by 512 pixels, with genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Input image 1: reference image for the exact atlas UV layout, subject placement and overall silhouette.
Composition/framing: Two equal square cells horizontally, no divider. Left half is one dense tropical broad-leaf palm/cordyline undergrowth clump, rooted at its own bottom center. It has erect and arching long pointed lance-shaped leaves; it is NOT a palm tree and has no trunk. Right half is exactly one upright fern frond, rooted at its own bottom center, with a clear central stem and a tapered triangular feather silhouette. No subjects overlap the center seam. Both subjects fill their own cells generously but remain entirely inside them. At 1024x512 leave 16–20 pixels of truly transparent margin at every outer edge and either side of the center seam, including below roots. Roots should end near y=490 and x=256 / x=768, respectively.
Style/medium: restrained art-directed game texture, hand-painted botanical realism with readable connected leaf masses and subtle painterly planar shading. Convincing leaves, composed to read clearly at small game size; simpler and more intentionally painted than a photograph. Muted military olive and deep fern greens with modest warm lighter green separation on overlapping leaves, no fluorescent greens. Soft diffuse daylight with enough midtone lift to preserve leaf detail in a shadowed jungle.
Constraints: preserve the two reference silhouettes and their orientation; crisp but natural alpha-cutout leaf edges and mostly solid opaque leaf interiors. A few natural variations and small notches are fine, but do not fragment the silhouettes into hairlike details. Transparent pixels must have actual zero alpha, not a painted checkerboard, not black background and not white background. No ground, cast shadows, pot, rock, scenery, extra plants, text, labels, grid, frame, watermark or decorative elements.

steps.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: attached generated foliage atlas.
This file accidentally has an opaque painted checkerboard. Remove every checkerboard/background pixel and deliver a PNG with a REAL alpha channel and zero alpha outside the two plants, including every gap between leaves. No visible background of any kind. Do not paint a checkerboard to represent transparency.
Preserve the exact leaf artwork, muted olive-green colors, natural edge detail, left broad-leaf undergrowth clump and right single upright fern. Preserve a horizontal 2:1 image with two equal square UV cells. Put the left clump entirely inside its left square: root at horizontal center of that square and transparent margin of at least 3% of cell width around all edges. Put fern entirely inside its right square with the same safe margins and its root at bottom center. Neither plant may touch canvas edges or cross the middle seam. Leave zero-alpha separation at the seam. No new objects, no shadows, no scenery, no lettering. Prefer 1024 by 512 PNG with genuine RGBA transparency.
